canonical.title: Weekend at Moor Hall: lodging, day-trips and tech detours within 30 km of Aughton

sources.title: Moor Hall — About
sources.claim: Moor Hall is at Prescot Road, Aughton L39 6RT — a Grade II*-listed mid-16th-c. house on five acres.

sources.title: Moor Hall — Restaurant with Rooms
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars under chef-patron Mark Birchall, 14 bedrooms across main house, gatehouse and Garden Rooms.

sources.title: Moor Hall — Rooms
sources.claim: Gatehouse from £275, Main House £300–£425, Garden Rooms £450–£500 B&B.

sources.title: Moor Hall — Garden Rooms
sources.claim: Garden Rooms named after botanicals — Melilot, Sea Buckthorn, Woodruff, Sweet Cicely, Oxalis, Borage, Anise Hyssop.

sources.title: Koto — at Moor Hall
sources.claim: Garden Rooms are seven prefab Koto cabins (Scandinavian timber, outdoor hot tubs), opened July 2024.

sources.title: Visit Lancashire — Moor Hall
sources.claim: Five rooms in the main hall, two in the gatehouse by the lake, seven Garden Rooms in the grounds; from £270 B&B.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Moor Hall
sources.claim: Three-star restaurant in Aughton, Lancashire.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Moor Hall closures
sources.claim: Moor Hall rooms close 1–17 January and 27 July–16 August each year.

sources.title: Hot Dinners — Moor Hall review
sources.claim: Tasting menu cited as ~£235 for eight courses (2025); Town Green station a 15-min walk from the restaurant.

sources.title: Birches Brow
sources.claim: 18th-c. house in a small Aughton hamlet, eight to nine boutique guestrooms, breakfast basket delivered to the room.

sources.title: Birches Brow — Hotel near Moor Hall
sources.claim: Markets itself as the closest place to stay near Moor Hall.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Birches Brow
sources.claim: £4.50 taxi to Moor Hall; owner sometimes offers lifts; rated 4.5/5 over 126 reviews.

sources.title: Briars Hall Hotel
sources.claim: 1745 country house hotel set in 5 acres of mature gardens and woodlands in Lathom.

sources.title: Kayak — Briars Hall
sources.claim: Briars Hall rooms booked from ~£99/night on Kayak in recent weeks.

sources.title: Holland Hall
sources.claim: 17th-c. Grade II listed building (built 1654) in Upholland; 25 en-suite rooms; Lovels Bistro on site.

sources.title: The Farm Burscough
sources.claim: 4-star B&B inside a renovated 18th-c. brick barn with tea-room and farm shop.

sources.title: The Secret Garden Glamping
sources.claim: Skelmersdale glamping — pods, lodges and yurts with private hot tubs, outdoor cinemas, saunas and cold plunges.

sources.title: The Vincent Hotel
sources.claim: Designer boutique on Lord Street, Southport — 'New York chic'.

sources.title: Merseyrail — Town Green
sources.claim: Nearest Merseyrail station to Moor Hall with a local taxi rank (01695 575 050).

sources.title: Rufford Old Hall (NT)
sources.claim: Tudor hall ~15 min N of Aughton; house 11:00–16:30 Saturday, adult £13.

sources.title: Speke Hall (NT)
sources.claim: Speke Hall house is closed on Saturdays in 2026; gardens 10:00–17:00 only.

sources.title: Formby (NT)
sources.claim: Lifeboat Road and Victoria Road car parks 09:00–17:00 (£9); beach open all day; dogs welcome.

sources.title: Formby Guide
sources.claim: Victoria Road car park & toilets closed to spring 2026; use Lifeboat Road or arrive by train.

sources.title: Formby red squirrels
sources.claim: Formby sits in the North Merseyside / West Lancashire red squirrel stronghold.

sources.title: Crosby — Another Place plan
sources.claim: Hall Road L23 8SY is closest car park; Merseyrail trains every ~15 min to Hall Road / Blundellsands / Waterloo.

sources.title: Another Place (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: 100 cast-iron, life-size Gormley figures across 3 km of foreshore and almost 1 km out to sea.

sources.title: WWT Martin Mere
sources.claim: Wetland centre at Burscough ~10 min north of Moor Hall.

sources.title: Martin Mere — tickets
sources.claim: Adult advance £17.10, Junior £11.12, Family £48.11 (on-the-day £19 / £12.35 / £53.45).

sources.title: Beacon Country Park
sources.claim: 300+ acres of meadow, woodland and ponds — free parking, café and Tramper hire.

sources.title: Burscough Wharf
sources.claim: Canal-side food cluster on the Leeds-Liverpool Canal: Baja Mexican, Cactus Ray's, Gurkha Village, Hugo's, Milkie Bar, Only Scrans, The Thirsty Duck.

sources.title: Ormskirk Market
sources.claim: Open-air market every Thursday and Saturday 08:00–16:30 across Moor, Aughton and Church Streets, up to 100 stalls.

sources.title: Southport Year of Culture 2026
sources.claim: First-ever Southport Year of Culture in 2026: Lightport, Big Top Festival, Books Alive!

sources.title: Southport Pier — repairs
sources.claim: Southport Pier closed since 2022; ~14-month repair works begin early 2026, so it is shut throughout the year.

sources.title: Marine Lake Events Centre
sources.claim: £73m+ Marine Lake Events Centre under construction; hoardings visible on the Southport lakefront.

sources.title: Knowsley Safari
sources.claim: Drive-through safari ~13 miles / 25 min from Aughton, open 10:00–17:00 with last Safari Drive entry 16:00.

sources.title: Windmill Animal Farm
sources.claim: Burscough family animal farm, open daily 10:00–17:00 (booking required).

sources.title: Farmer Ted's
sources.claim: Adventure farm near Ormskirk/Formby; weekends 10:00–17:15, season 12 Feb–6 Sep 2026.

sources.title: Liverpool Cathedral
sources.claim: Open Saturday 10:00–18:00 with Tower last entry 16:30; free admission.

sources.title: Royal Albert Dock
sources.claim: Free open-air heritage waterfront — most-visited free attraction in North West England.

sources.title: The Beatles Story
sources.claim: Royal Albert Dock; Saturday 09:00–18:30 (last entry 17:15), £20 adult.

sources.title: Cavern Club
sources.claim: Mathew Street; Sat 11:00–02:00, £6 entry / £8.50 all-day pass, cashless.

sources.title: Walker Art Gallery
sources.claim: Saturday 10:00–17:00, free admission — strong wet-weather plan B.

sources.title: Sefton Park Palm House
sources.claim: Free Victorian glasshouse, daily 10:30–18:30 in summer.

sources.title: Liverpool Gin Distillery
sources.claim: Castle Street; Tue–Thu 12:00–00:00, Fri–Sun 12:00–01:00. Gin Tasting £38.50pp.

sources.title: Discover Ormskirk — eat & drink
sources.claim: The Kicking Donkey near Ormskirk: gastropub praised for fish & chips.

sources.title: Owd Barn
sources.claim: 16th-c. listed barn at Bispham (Ormskirk) — farm shop, tea room, farmhouse meals.

sources.title: Distance — Ormskirk → Manchester
sources.claim: Ormskirk to central Manchester: 44 km straight-line / 56 km road — Manchester tech venues sit outside the 30 km radius.

sources.title: DTX Manchester / Manchester Tech Week
sources.claim: Manchester Tech Week 27 Apr–1 May 2026; DTX Manchester 29–30 Apr at Manchester Central — outside the radius.

sources.title: LCR Innovation Investment Fortnight
sources.claim: Innovation Investment Fortnight runs 1–12 June 2026 with 20+ events across life sciences, maritime, games, AI and sports science.

sources.title: LCR AI Summit
sources.claim: LCR AI Summit at ACC Liverpool on 23 October 2026; Youth AI Summit 20 Oct at The Spine; International AI Summit 21 Nov at Liverpool Boxpark.

sources.title: FinTech North Liverpool 2026
sources.claim: 19 March 2026 at Camp and Furnace, Baltic Triangle — WealthTech, InsurTech and regional FinTech.

sources.title: Tech Climbers LCR launch
sources.claim: Tech Climbers LCR 2026 launch 10 Feb at Cotton Exchange, Bixteth Street, L3 9LQ.

sources.title: Merseyside Hackathon 2026
sources.claim: 11–12 May 2026 at LJMU, organised by BCS — two-day hybrid sprint for HE students.

sources.title: LCR Innovation Investment Summit
sources.claim: Fifth LCR Innovation Investment Summit on 4 June 2026 at The Spine, Paddington Village.

sources.title: Baltic Ventures Accelerator
sources.claim: Sept–Nov 2026 in the Baltic Triangle; Demo Day 26 Nov; up to £100k funding per startup.

sources.title: Edge Hill University events
sources.claim: 2026 Higher Education Learning & Teaching Conference 16–17 June 2026 at Edge Hill (Ormskirk).

sources.title: Dot NET Liverpool
sources.claim: 1,666-member meetup at Barclays Eagle Lab (Mann Island) and Baltic Ventures (Simpson St).

sources.title: AI Tinkerers Liverpool
sources.claim: Monthly AI-engineers meetup with live code demos; part of a 220-city, 104k-member network.

sources.title: BCS Merseyside Branch
sources.claim: BCS Merseyside (Liverpool + South Lancashire) runs talks year-round.
